run_mypy_typecheck: run mypy type-checking on the LabGraph source code using a config file
test_typecheck_function: test the LabGraph codebase for type errors by invoking mypy in a subprocess
extract_and_typecheck_zip: extract Python files from a typecheck source zip archive and run mypy on them
typecheck_installed_labgraph: typecheck the installed LabGraph package location by globbing all Python files
review_test_typecheck: review the test_typecheck function that validates LabGraph types via mypy subprocess execution
